capabilities: Render tikz and latex code blocks as SVG diagrams
Auto-wrap snippets in a customizable standalone preamble
Compile full standalone documents with custom documentclass and packages
Recolor diagram lines and text to match the active light/dark theme
Cache compiled SVGs in IndexedDB and diagnose the toolchain from settings
extras: Desktop-only plugin that executes the local latex compiler and dvisvgm via child_process; makes no network calls and documents security measures and Windows MiKTeX troubleshooting. Beta releases are available via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Forked from the Obsidian TikZJax plugin by @artisticat1.
motivation: The author wanted full access to the local TeX package ecosystem instead of the limited package support of WebAssembly-based renderers.
problem: Obsidian's built-in math rendering and WebAssembly-based TikZ solutions support only a limited set of packages, so diagrams using tools like pgfplots or chemfig cannot be compiled.

relations.evidence: Forked from the Obsidian TikZJax plugin by @artisticat1.
Inspired by the TikZJax project by @kisonecat.

requires.name: A LaTeX distribution (MiKTeX, TeX Live, or MacTeX) and dvisvgm available in the system PATH

summary: Renders TikZ and LaTeX code blocks to vector SVG diagrams using the local system TeX installation, with support for any installed package.
